avis.texte: The serum leaked from the seams at the pump portion and bottom parts of the bottle. So much product was wasted. So frustrating considering the price of it.

avis.titre: Good product but the packaging leaks
avis.texte: Product is really nice. It goes on easy and doesn't irritate my skin but the packaging leaks from the bottom and from the spout. I doesn't appear damaged in any way. I'd expect better packaging from a product at this price range.

I love this serum so much, it makes my skin look and feel great. It goes on like an oil, which is great for my dry skin. I love how smooth my makeup applies when i wear this underneath. I love the glow it gives me and it's just all around great. I hope they never discontinue this!

There are two holes built into the bottom of the bottle which somehow causes the serum to leak at all times. This stained and ruined my white marble countertop leaving rings. Really unnacceptable given the price point of the item. It is also much more oily than expected.

I've tried many vitamin C serums & finally found my favorite. After ~4 mos of use, my skin looks brighter & the texture on the sides of my face a little less obvious - my skin overall looks more fresh. This also lays very nicely under moisturizer & makeup (I use La Roche Posay ceramide moisturizer, tinted screen, Kosas cloud powder.) Highly recommend!

I love how it is moisturizing but doesn't stay greasy. It sinks in and eventually is matte. Good for all skin types (I am oily). Definitely makes my skin feel healthier and glowy! This is the best vitamin C serum I have tried.
I've seen progress in my dark acne spots. The serum takes a while to dry and leaves a sticky feeling. I do like the product and it has lasted me a long time.

avis.titre: Great product, not a fan of the smell
avis.texte: It's a fair trade though , it's no worse than other vitamin c serums (at least the ones that actually work).

avis.titre: great addition to my skin care regimen
avis.texte: I added Farmacy's vitamin C serum to my morning skin care routine four months ago to help with mild pigmentation issues. I love the results! Besides gradually lightening areas of pigmentation, my skin has a healthy glow without looking greasy or shiny. Friends, family and strangers frequently comment how great my skin looks, which my 62 year old self loves to hear.
Tried it during a free trial size and loved it a lot so purchasing a full size!

Love the product! I feel like it has really brightened my skin. A little goes a long way with this product. The *only* downfall is that the serum leaks a bit from the container (user error? maybe, but annoying nonetheless). I cut the box it comes in so it's a container to hold the serum so it can't fall over and place a little piece of toilet paper/paper towel in the bottom of the box to catch any spillage.

I like the product, but the packaging is awful. I have fair, freckly skin and it helped a lot to lighten my freckles and brighten my skin. However, every time I pump the dispenser for the product, it leaks out all through the top and gets everywhere. My stone lazy Suzan stand that I keep my skincare on was stained by the leaking. I'm throwing the remainder away and moving to a different brand for vit. C. Farmacy still has my loyalty for the honey halo moisturizer and the honey milk though!

I can't even use the product there is liquid in there but nothing comes out. I just opened it and the packaging is terrible I thought after a day it would dispense product but nope I keep pumping the pump and 0 product comes out.
It makes my skin feel more oily than before using this product
Loved it, but it turned my eyebrows slowly orange. Find a vitamin c with Sodium ascorbyl phosphate (stable and won't oxidize) instead of L-absorbic acid (unstable and does oxidize).

I have tried soo many different vitamin C serums and this is the best one at the best price point for what you get. It is like an oil and I love how well it absorbs into my skin. For me, anything stronger than 10% vitamin C tends to irritate me and even cause breakouts. The active ingredients read like the CE Ferulic from Skinsceuticals which people rave over at a much better price point and without any water!

avis.titre: Love Vit C - but packaging can be improved
avis.texte: Have been using Farmacy products for 3 years now. Love everything about it. This Vit C serum is amazing. I do have one feedback about the packaging: every time i take the bottle in carry on it leaks. It happened almost every time i took it on a plane. probably bc of the pressure.

I am 32 years old, underwent Accutane treatment last year for cystic acne and recently started developing superficial acne all over my face. Two weeks ago I switched my skincare routine from a different brand to Farmacy and as someone who has tried MANY skincare brands and unable to find one that works for me, I am in shock over the results!! Using this serum and the Daily Greens moisturizer morning and night, the acne started to clear up within two days and now my skin is acne free, smooth, and more radiant than it's ever been! I've been telling everyone I can about this brand- I am SO grateful I found them!! :)
I like how hydrating this serum feels, while still being lightweight and fast absorbing.
Good product but a leaking container when its upside down! :( this just wasted so much product and makes it impossible to travel with! I won't buy it again!

avis.titre: Great to get rid of dark spots
avis.texte: I had a lot of dark spots on my face after my last pregnancy. This has helped fade them all. I am really happy with my skin now.

I love the texture of Farmacy serums. This one is perfect. Not runny or watery (as the name suggests). The results are fantastic. My skin has never looked better! I use this along with a handful of other Farmacy products for my acne-prone, but aging skin. So pleased with the overall improvement in breakouts, texture, and hydration. My skin is glowy and healthy.

I love this product, I've been using it for a couple weeks now since I bought a smaller sized bottle. My only issue is the packaging for the smaller bottle, it's not that great. It leaks product all the time especially when actively dispensing product.
A good half of the bottle goes to waste. The container leaks tops and bottom.
The product is great but my container is leaking. The customer service reached out and said this is not acceptable. A new container is on the way!
This vitamin c serum really brightened my skin. I will buy it again.
The product is great but it's leaking from the top and the bottom of the container. A waste of money when almost half of it leaks out.

I LOVED this 10% Waterless Vitamin C Serum, it not only left me feeling moisturized & hydrated but it left me brighter & moisturized! I LOVED this, I have bought this over & over a couple times! It is AMAZING & I would definitely purchase again when I'm ready to purchase another Vitamin C Serum! It's really that good! I recommend!
I wanted to love this product but the smell is off putting. It also doesn't absorb as well as. A lot of other farmacy products and weirdly warms on the face when I rub it in? I wouldn't buy again.

Let me start by saying I have loved every Farmacy product I have ever tried. Until now. I can barely get through my bottle of the waterless vitamin c serum. The smell is almost unbearable and that is so unexpected from a Farmacy product. I typically love the smell of all of Farmacy products but this is just terrible. I don't like the oily feeling of the serum either. It just doesn't feel nice to me and makes using it a chore. Sadly I will not be repurchasing. If you were a Very Cherry Bright user I definitely recommend getting a travel size first to see if you like this product because it is VERY different. I used VCB for several years and i have no clue why it was discontinued. It was the best . Not sure where to go from here :( Very disappointing.

I've been using this vitamin c serum for almost 2 months now (day + night) and I truly see a difference! I've never used a skincare product so consistently before and can definitely say this is changing my skin. I have less redness and feel overall more balanced + radiant. Definitely repurchasing and will continue to use.

I love this product and my skin loves it too. I have one constructive criticism that had nothing to do with the product but mostly with the container. I travel a lot for business and usually have to carry my skincare routine with me. I noticed frequently that the serum is all over the pump and cap. I am not sure what the issue is but I know that I'm losing the product because I have to wipe it off the bottle whenever it ends up on its side. It would be lovely if maybe you change the dispensation way.
Love this stuff. I use it everyday and my skin is looking sweet. Love the way it goes on and blends in so well.

I've been using this serum daily in the AM and I'm really noticing a difference thanks to consistent use. In the PM, I use Honeymoon Glow. Love both and feel I've really getting a "glow from within" look based on my regular use of these.

Purchased this product a little over 2 months ago. The packaging is awful - it leaks every single time you use it. When you apply it to your face, it's warm and not pleasant. I have seen zero to no results.
Have gone through a few bottles of this now and I just love it. Love the feeling of it. Absorbs well into skin.

The vitamin C is a must have addition to my daily skin care routine. it has helped to even my skin and makes it silky smooth. it doesn't create additional oil on my already oily skin. This has been my highest recommended product to all my friends. If you don't have some, GET SOME!

I have lots of dark spots and discoloration. I am not sure it has helped fade them at all but it definitely makes my skin look brighter and healthier. I put it on every morning and then layer Honey Halo on top and it looks beautiful under makeup.

Definitely feel like my skin texture is smoother and my complexion is brighter when I use this vitamin c serum. This is one of the few that I've found that is truly activated, and I'm on my 3rd bottle! Highly recommend.

After trying several other vitamin C's on the market, this is the only one I trust. While the texture was not quite similar to others, that is no problem - it instantly evens skin tone and brightens complexion. It's also long lasting and perfect for day and night use. Highly recommend!
I've been using this product for a few weeks and my skin is already looking brighter and healthier. Loving it so far

Take this review with a grain of salt because I didn't actually use the product long term. That's because I couldn't get past the awful smell and sticky texture. It has that signature vitamin C hotdog water scent. It's really overpowering. The texture is what made me decide to return it though. It's a very thin, runny but somehow also extremely sticky texture. It reminded me of thinner corn syrup. It just wasn't pleasant and wasn't the product for me unfortunately.

This has been my favorite vitamin C I've tried, having used both budget and higher-end, my skin has loved this the most. This absorbs into my skin well, and has made a noticeable difference in my skin tone and texture. I routinely read vitamin C serums should be stored in an opaque and airless container as well, so this product checks all the boxes!

I use this at night before I go to bed. I wake up with a smooth, firm, and clear complexion. I was using another vitamin C serum for years and I am now hooked on this Farmacy Waterless Vitamin C Serum! Amazing stuff!
I have tried many versions of Vitamin C, and this is the first that does not discolor! It absorbs very quickly and is wonderful for daily use.
I love the feeling of this serum on my skin! The serum is light and not too heavy. I have been using the serum for about a month and have received so many compliments of how bright my skin looks.

avis.titre: I think this might be my favorite Farmacy product
avis.texte: I really noticed a difference on my pigmentation and the brightness of my skin (I am a freckle face with a larger spot of pigmentation that I don't love). I love this product, and I would buy a larger size if they made it!
I love using this product! It glides so well on the skin and creates a glowy complexion. 10/10!

This is the only vitamin c serum that hasn't irritated my skin or broken me out. I have tried many other popular brands but always get a rash or break out. I feel like it has helped my fine lines since using it.

avis.titre: by far my favorite vitamin C serum right now
avis.texte: it is the perfect consistency and I notice an improvement in my complexion (less dull, more even). I love this product!
Compared to the original vitamin C, this is no good. It's oily and breaks me out unfortunately. The other one was weightless and absorbent. Really miss it....
This serum instantly brightens my face! I incorporate this product into my daily skincare routine. One of the best vitamin C serums I've tried.
Truly made a big difference in my skin. No breakouts. Dewy and bright. Been using 3 weeks.
The vitamin c serum is good for my skin, but the worst part is the leakage!!

I been looking for vitamin C and tried other but nothing really works with my skin. But when I tried this one. My skin loves it and I see the results in one week. Definitely will sticking with this one.
This is my second bottle and I love it. I love that it's thicker and has a mild warming sensation when I put it on. It feels more active that other formulas I've tried.

avis.titre: Not better than the Cherry Serum
avis.texte: I am sad the Cherry Serum is gone and while I have one more unopened bottle to use it, I decided to try the brand new vitamin C serum. After using it for a while like a good 2 months here I am not sure its worth it. The results are similar but this greasy feeling bothers me when I put it on. In fact it lingers on my skin for a good hour so the absorption is slow.Feels oily and sticky for at least an hour. Not good in my opinion. One of the things I can't stand about Farmacy is they do not give options of the type we like. They force us to adapt to changes. Why can't we have both Cherry serum or this Waterless base serum to choose. Not everyone is going to be happy with just one option. Let us pick please.In other words, can we get the Cherry back please? Be a loyal customer for years too.

I have been using The Ordinary products layered under Farmacy's Honey Halo (my all time favorite). When this item first came out, I wanted to give it a try but never thought I would like it as much or more than The Ordinary. I prefer to use all products within the same brand to keep things simple and I am pleased to say that I love these new products by Farmacy. My face feels amazingly soft, smooth, and supple. I found the only way I can achieve these results is by layering good and effective products such as these. Thank you for coming out with such amazing (and clean) products!
I love Farmacy but this product was disappointing. It might just be that I prefer water-based formulas, but I found the texture of this product very difficult to work with.

avis.titre: Does Not Live Up to the Acerola Cherry Serum
avis.texte: The Acerola Cherry Vitamin C Serum was my absolute favourite and I am devasted to see it replaces, but I tried this anyway. I do not necessarily enjoy the experience of applying this serum. It is a tacky oil texture, though it spreads well enough. Has a strong propolis smell which is to be expected with Farmacy products (but where does that come from, because it doesn't contain propolis). It does eventually asborb, though it does take a bit. I don't hate it, but it does not bring me the joy of the acerola serum.

I am new to Farmacy, and wasn't sure what to expect with this serum. I have been using it daily for about 2 months and see a significant improvement in my dark spots. I have noticed an added benefit of this serum being a fantastic face primer, and I've tried so many primers all of which "pill" up after applying anything on top. After cleansing and using the Vitamin C Serum, no matter what skin care products I put on afterwards including Farmacy moisturizers, liquid foundation, concealers, etc., there is no pilling or settling in fine lines. I'll never go without the Vitamin C Serum as the first step in my makeup routine. My "mature" complexion has improved so much by using all of the Farmacy skin care products! I have more radiance and my skin is less dry. I'm definitely glad I found this line of products!

I wanted to love this serum. I love the vitamin C very cherry serum. I was hoping that this would be very similar or even better. However, I found this for me to be very much like an oil. I prefer the serum as I feel it absorbs much better. My fingers are crossed that this the cherry serum will return, or some thing similar.
Smooth application, makes my everyday morning routine feel great and clean! I love using the filling good hyaluronic acid serum after and my skin has been glowing since !
I really liked the cherry Vitamin C serum, but this one has a great texture!

I think it's a little too soon to see big results but I have noticed a smoother texture and tone change. What I love is how lightweight it is and the fact it's unscented. I bought two more bottles so I'd have backups!
I've been using this vitamin c serum for about 6 months now and I've noticed a huge difference in the evenness of my skin tone! It's so lightweight and can be worn under makeup beautifully!

avis.titre: Great product, but the cap leaks
avis.texte: I love the product, but out of the two bottles I've used, both caps have leaked! I just opened my second bottle only to discover that it leaked in the box before use.

I finally caved and bought the full size Vitamin C after trying sample sizes and realizing how much I love having it in my routine. My skin feels so smooth and it's helped with my uneven tones that I've struggled with.

Oooh my skin is feeling so bright and fresh after using this toner for a week! I have a little discoloration and am already seeing improvement to the color. Hoping with more use this evens out my complexion - so far it's amazing!!
After six weeks my skin is brighter , and smoother, I use it every other day as part of my routine.

Farmacy is such a good skincare brand! I love all things vitamin c and brightening so i knew this would be the perfect product for myself. i need more time with it but so far i am happy with the results!

avis.titre: The best vitamin C on the market
avis.texte: I've tried many vitamin c products and none provided results the way this one does. It may feel heavy or greasy at first so if you're oily you may not enjoy it. But. this stuff works on dark spots.
Amazing serum that has lightened all my pigmentations and evened out my skin tone! It works amazing and on top of this, the smell of the vitamin C is wonderful.
I really like the way it feels. I can't say for sure that it's making a difference yet as I've only been using a short time, but I feel like it might be
I have been using this product for a few months and have literally seen my dark spots lighten. It was so cool that my husband actually started using the vitamin c serum as well. Great product.
I love all the Farmacy products I have tried, but this one. my face is glowing! Love it!

avis.titre: Light Weight & Feels Good On My Face
avis.texte: I have been using the Farmacy Vitamin C Serum for about 2 weeks now, and already see changes in my complexion. I have a few brown spots on my face and they have faded a little already! The serum goes on smoothly, it's not oily or sticky and smells a little like oranges. It dries almost right away and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I will continue to use this product as long as it works for my skin. I am 54 years old and my face tends to be a little dry. This serum helps a little with that and does not dry my face out more.

I used this for a couple of weeks in the am and their Retinal in the pm with average results. My skin is very tough but I still experienced the tell tale signs of using a retinal. BUT THEN.. I started putting the Farmacy Vitamin C on before the retinal. I do a full big pump of both. I don't wait between. I don't need to add any moisturizers, my acne has decreased, I have no sensitivity, my skin is vibrant and glowy every single morning. I'm blown away. I've used a lot of similar products and in my opinion these two are high quality and very effective for the price, when used correctly.
Very nourishing; it feels like vitamin C going right into your pours.

I received the tester size in a previous order & loved it! It really just added a much needed step to my day time skin care. I felt as though I noticed my skin looking brighter. I will say it is definitely out of my price range but it really does work well!

I finished the first bottle of this vitamin C serum and moving on to the 2nd one. Honestly, I didn't like it initially because it made my fingers feel greasy after putting it on my face. The serum though keeps my face hydrated and surprisingly absorbs right in. I'm giving it 3 stars because I do not notice any differences on my dark spots so I don't think it's working for me. I will be moving on to a different brand after the 2nd bottle.
I have a lot of acne scarring & I feel like this does help even out my skin tone when used both am and pm.
I love it, it has helped me a lot to fade acne marks, when I apply it my face looks and feels super radiant

I love the honeymoon glow from Farmacy so was really looking forward to adding in the vitamin c serum to my rotation. I've tried different vitamin C serums and unfortunately this is the only serum I've had a reaction to. Every time I try this serum I get red blotchy skin especially around my eyes and on my neck. I definitely can't put this serum on and then go out without having red rings around my eyes. Unfortunately I bought this serum before finishing the other serum I was using and didn't test it before the return period ended. bummer. I will say for pros: minimal smell, rubs in well, a little goes a long ways, layers well, and very light.

avis.titre: Seems to firm it up a little
avis.texte: I layer this on before Honey Halo and my skin is loving it. So far I'm using it three nights a week, alternating with Honeymoon Glow.
I use this whenever I feel my skin needs a "pick me up." I just got a complement asking what I use for skin care because my skin looks so good!
I got the sample size of this product and absolutely love it. My skin feels and looks amazing! As soon as my sample gets low, I'm order a full-size because it's a must on my skincare routine.
Super happy to finally have found a vitamin C product that doesn't smell like kitty litter.
I enjoy the oil like formula, it's hydrating and I've noticed my skin tone appears more even.

I used to get the vitamin c Very Cherry Bright serum. I will say, I liked the smell of that one much better however, the feeling of this one is unmatched. It goes on very smooth and absorbs quickly. My face feels hydrated and smooth immediately after I put it on. So relieved that I found a replacement that I was so happy with!

I've tried a few Vitamin C serums and this one is by far my favorite! Great texture, not sticky and goes on smoothly. Already seeing great results and excited to see my skin when I use it for a longer amount of time
I have used many vitamin C serums over the years. Most of them have a funny smell and are sticky or tacky. This one is great, and I will be continuing to use in the future.
My favorite Vitamin C serum of them all. A little bit goes a long way!

I have tried other Vitamin C serums and they have not worked near as well as this one! It is a thicker consistency which I appreciate and my sun spots are starting to fade. No other product has ever done that!
I really enjoyed using this product. However, the packaging wasn't good. It leaked from the dispenser but also from seams at the top of the bottle.
Simple ingredients that pack a punch. My skin looks and feels better since starting to use this. Been using it since it was released and I can never switch to any other vitamin C serum.
Skin feels healthy and looks very radiant. You truly feel and look fresh from around 8-14hrs perfect for two daily skin care routine cycles.
I love this serum! I do t even need moisturizer after the serum. It leaves my skin do hydrated. My skin looks really good

I love this serum, it starts out as an oily consistency but quickly absorbs into my skin. I've been using it daily for a couple of weeks and my skin looks brighter! Being from Minnesota, It's my secret weapon to combat winter dullness

This is by far the best vitamin C serum I have used! I have been using it for about 3-4 weeks now and can already see a difference in my skin radiance and acne scarring! It's very light weight! The smell is a little strong and weird but I can get over it for the effects it has on my skin! I use it every morning with the honey halo moisturizer and apply sunscreen with it as well!
This is the only Vitamin C serum I have found with CLEAN ingredients that truly works and isn't overpriced. Love the brand and the product.

I've recently started noticing dark circles under my eyes. It doesn't matter what I do to try and hide them, they were definitely still visible. I have never seen or heard of a waterless serum and 10% Vitamin C at that, I figured I'd give it a try. That was about 5 months ago. I just purchased my second bottle. This product brightens my skin in a way I have never seen before. The dark circles are barely there. And the best part, this product works so well under my make up. I'm obsessed! Will continue to purchase.
Saw a reduction in dark spots and overall brighter skin in just a few days. Goes on a little sticky but drys down quickly and does not affect makeup.

I have implemented this serum in my am and pm routine. From the first use I have noticed a viable change in the brightness and firmness of my face. The formula is perfect and does not leave any stick residue on my face. I will definitely be buying again once I am out.

avis.titre: The best Vitamin C on the market
avis.texte: Love this product. I saw immediate results in my dark spots, they started to fade and overall pigmentation and evenness of my skin tone really show. I love that the product is in an opaque packaging keeping the VC stable unlike so many other brands using clear glass or plastic where the VC loses efficacy when exposed to light.

I have being using pharmacy products for a while now and I luv them. Got the vitamin c serum and really wanted to like it too. Unfortunately it gives me rashes all over my face every time I try to use it. Guess will not be buying it again.
got this after my friends told me able this brand and haven't turned back since! great on my skin
I use everyday and have seen dark spots disappear. Smoother skin on my face. I love vitamin C serum. I will always have this to use. Highly recommended.

I've been using this serum for about 6 months now, along with the honey moisturizer and Vit A serum at night. I feel my skin is far more hydrated and overall in better shape. I go for a facial every 3 months and this time my therapist said my skin was tighter, more moisturized and clearer overall. I certainly don't ever feel dry anymore because of these three products - No more Image products for me!
This is the first vitamin c serum I have used but it has made a big difference on my skin tone and has faded dark spots on my skin. Definitely purchasing again!

I used to use the Very Cherry Bright serum, which I LOVED, but when it was discontinued I decided to give this a try. At first I didn't like the oilier feel when applying - it didn't feel as lightweight as the Very Cherry Bright - however, once I got used to it, I loved how it made my skin look & feel: visibly brighter, even-toned, and supple. I follow with the Daily Greens oil-free gel moisturizer, which seems to balance nicely, and leaves my skin feeling refreshed.

I've used several other vitamin C serums in the past but none alleviated my dark spots. I've ordered this twice now and the dark spots on my neck are gone. Fingers crossed for the remaining on my cheeks.
